requirements: Narrative-only profiles contain an explicit none mechanics section and validate for every archetype.
Light and Full profiles share identical level, ability-derived combat values, protection, equipment, and main attack for the same seed.
Full profiles include all six abilities, all three saves, complete trained skills, initiative, speed, attacks, and challenge band.
Generated and exact levels remain inside archetype guidance.
Exact out-of-range levels clamp with a non-error diagnostic.
Mechanics rerolls do not alter unrelated sections.
